title: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙
full_text: Article 3 (Payment to Joint Litigation Performers) Where at least two persons jointly conduct litigation in the same case, they shall be deemed to constitute one litigation performer for purposes of monetary rewards, and the amount of the reward under Article 4 shall be divided equally among them.
